# =====================================================================
# CWIC Super Event popup filter  (auto-generated)
# Evaluated per receiving player; ROOT = the source country of the event.
# Preference country flags (unset = default "show all"):
#   CWIC_se_pref_off          -> master: never show popups
#   CWIC_se_pref_majors       -> only show popups for major-power events
#   CWIC_se_pref_own_majors   -> show own-country events + major-power events
# =====================================================================
CWIC_should_show_super_event = {
	NOT = { has_country_flag = CWIC_se_pref_off }
	OR = {
		AND = {
			NOT = { has_country_flag = CWIC_se_pref_majors }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = CWIC_se_pref_own_majors }
		}
		AND = {
			has_country_flag = CWIC_se_pref_majors
			ROOT = { is_major = yes }
		}
		AND = {
			has_country_flag = CWIC_se_pref_own_majors
			OR = { ROOT = { is_major = yes } tag = ROOT }
		}
	}
}
